scope: infected attack animations preserving historical appearance variants
notes: Each original PNG is copied byte-for-byte; the final alpha-9 rectangles cover every source pixel with alpha > 8 and include no foreign body pixel.
The final measured rectangles retain antialiased contours and 606 pixels in 517 tiny detached edge fragments, all attributed to the cut of their own pose. No significant fragment remains unassigned.
At alpha > 8, the PNG borders, all 160 cut borders, and the area outside the used cuts contain zero pixels.
The nominal four-by-four grid is advisory; measured rectangles preserve whole boots and hands crossing a nominal grid line.
No shield is baked into either shielded appearance; existing shields remain separate gameplay overlays.
Crawler sources are separately generated four-by-two sheets to keep prone bodies complete.

sources.prompt: Create a production 2D game ATTACK ANIMATION SPRITE SHEET by editing the exact characters in the two reference images. Output exactly 1536 by 1024 pixels, transparent background, NO text, labels, grid lines, gradients, floor, shadows, objects, weapons, extra figures or effects. 4 columns by 4 rows, each cell 384 by 256 pixels, exactly ONE COMPLETE humanoid in each cell, facing RIGHT. Keep every figure completely inside its cell with 35 pixels of clear transparent gutter on all sides. Figures fit maximum 310 pixels wide by 196 pixels high. Stable whole-body scale and anchor for all eight poses per appearance. These are STATIONARY MELEE ATTACK poses, NOT a walking/running cycle; feet planted by the same anchor, arms and torso articulate through eight distinct poses in exact sequence: ready crouch with elbows bent, hands drawn back, shoulders wind up, arms accelerating outward, hands fully thrust forward/contact, torso at maximum forward lean and hands recoiling slightly, elbows drawing back, recovery crouch. Hands never hold tools. Serious realistic hand-painted dark survival-game sprites, same lighting, skin, costume and CAMERA of each respective source. Preserve original appearance closely: this is a new action for the SAME PERSON; do not redesign, change wardrobe, gender, equipment, haircut, build, or camera. FIRST TWO ROWS read left-to-right = eight attack poses of BASE appearance. LAST TWO ROWS = eight attack poses of ALTERNATE appearance. Avoid duplicating a gait frame; each pose's arm position must be meaningfully distinct. All body parts unclipped. No fake fantasy mutation, skeleton, spikes, magic or oversized claws. BASE: use ONLY row 4 of FIRST reference, ignoring all other rows. bald gray pale infected man, dirty GRAY bloody button shirt, olive trousers, brown boots; OVERHEAD camera looking down onto bowed shoulders and bald scalp, very little face. ALTERNATE: use ONLY row 4 of SECOND reference, ignoring all other rows. gray-haired elderly infected man, OLIVE GREEN worn long coat, BROWN trousers, brown cross-body satchel, brown boots; the reference's SIDE oblique/isometric view looking slightly down, visible body height. Especially preserve the DIFFERENT perspective between base and alternate whenever the references differ.
